0.0.n: Names the endpoint reached through your effort.

0.1.n: Marks 最後 as the endpoint: you continued all the way.

0.2.n: Past form of やり抜く, combining やる with 抜く to emphasize completing something despite difficulty.

0.3.n: Directly addresses the viewer who completed the quiz.

0.4.n: Marks あなた as the person the sentence is about.

0.5.n: A borrowed word, linked to 達人 by の to identify the area of expertise.

0.6.n: Connects クイズ to 達人, showing what the person excels at.

0.7.n: Describes someone highly skilled; here it praises the viewer's quiz ability.

0.8.n: Plain, informal form of です, making a confident declaration.

1.0.n: Together with ね, forms いいね, the label for a social media like.

1.1.n: Normally seeks agreement, but here belongs to いいね, used as a noun for a social media like.

1.2.n: Joins いいね and チャンネル登録 as the two things the viewer should do.

1.3.n: Combines with 登録 to refer to subscribing to this video channel.

1.4.n: With チャンネル and をする, expresses the action of subscribing to a channel.

1.5.n: Marks both いいね and チャンネル登録 as the actions performed with して.

1.6.n: The て-form of する links liking and subscribing to the following request.

1.8.n: 次 plus に specifies when to tackle the chosen quiz.

1.9.n: 挑戦 plus する describes the quiz you will attempt, rather than giving a separate command.

1.10.n: The preceding phrase 次に挑戦する specifies which quiz the viewer should choose.

1.11.n: Marks クイズ as the thing being decided on.

1.12.n: The て-form of 決める serves as an informal request here.

1.13.n: Softens the request and adds a friendly, encouraging tone.

0.lit: You who saw it through to the end are a master of quizzes!
0.tip: 最後までやり抜いた comes before あなた to describe you as the person who completed the challenge.

1.lit: Do a like and channel subscription, and choose the quiz you will take on next, okay!
1.tip: 次に挑戦する describes クイズ: Japanese places the description before the thing being described.
